analysis.summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited reported a standalone revenue of Rs. 79,910.58 lakhs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 2,000.94 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The management anticipated achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 lakhs for the current year and initiated necessary resources and efforts.

guidance.claim: The company anticipated achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 lakhs for the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

guidance.claim: The company anticipated achieving a gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year, for which necessary efforts have been initiated.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

capex_expansion.claim: During the year, the company incorporated its wholly-owned subsidiary, Amazo Solar Power Private Limited, and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as equity share capital.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year the Company incorporated its Wholly own Subsidiary i.e. Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as Equity Share Capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 29th May, 2026, have recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 1/- (Rupee One only) per equity share of Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, aggregating Rs. 1,36,23,552 for the F.Y. 2025-26, subject to the approval of Members at the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting of the Company and deduction of tax at source, as required under the law.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share of face value of Rs. 10 each for the financial year 2024-2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Re. 1/- (10%) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year 2024-2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance of total reserve and surplus as on March 31, 2024 amounted to Rs. 11,125.52 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result as on 31st March, 2024 the balance of total reserve and surplus is amounting to Rs. 11,125.52 Lakhs.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 lakhs during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

management_commitments.claim: The company planned to shift its registered office with effect from October 01, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Section 12(5) and other applicable provisions, if any, of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rules made thereunder (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment thereof for the time being in force), subject to such approvals, consents , sanctions and permissions from any appropriate authority(ies) as may be necessary, the consent of the Members be and is hereby accorded to shifting its Registered Office of the Company from “11-B, New Ahmedabad Industrial Estate, Sarkhej Bavla Road, Village Moraiya, Ahmedabad – 382213, Gujarat, India to Zaveri House, Fourth Floor, Sanidhya, Opp Planet Landmark Hotel, Bopal- Ambli Road, Bopal, Ahmedabad – 380058, Gujarat, India” with effect from October 01, 2025.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Niraj Trivedi was appointed as Secretarial Auditor to hold office from the conclusion of the AGM till the conclusion of the 46th AGM in the year 2030, covering the period from FY 2025-26 till FY 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: NIRAJ TRIVEDI, Practicing Company Secretaries having Peer Reviewed Certificate No. 1014/2020 be and is hereby appointed as the Secretarial Auditors of the Company for a period of five consecutive years to hold office from the conclusion of this Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of the 46th Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held in the year 2030, to conduct the Secretarial Audit of the Company for the period beginning from the FY 2025-26 till the FY 2029-30, at such remuneration as may be mutually agreed upon between the Board, based on the recommendation(s) of the Audit Committee, and the Secretarial Auditors of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Kishor Pranjivandas Mandalia is re-appointed as Managing Director and CEO for a further period of 5 years with effect from August 07, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: “RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Sections 196, 197, 198, 203 read with Schedule V and any other applicable provisions, if any of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made there under (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment thereof for the time being in force) and Articles of Association of the Company and subject to other approvals as may be necessary and based on the recommendation of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee and Board of Directors of the Company, the consent of the shareholders of the Company be and is hereby accorded to re-appoint Mr. Kishor Pranjivandas Mandalia (DIN: 00126209) as the Managing Director and CEO of the Company for a further period of 5 (Five) years with effect from August 07, 2025 upon such terms and conditions, including remuneration, as set out in the explanatory statement to the resolution as per item No. 4 of this Notice.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
